verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a free developer tier: a dev instance with up to 4 vCPU and 8 GB RAM, no credit card required. That gives a free sandbox for developing transformations outside production. It also documents throwaway branches of production data on isolated compute, plus CHKit commands to validate and test pipelines as code before deploying. missing for 10: a documented local engine or emulator for offline development, details on free-tier limits and dev-loop speed, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
